about: Walking on Waves has run surf lessons in North Devon since 2003 and calls itself Saunton's original surf school. Lessons meet at Saunton Sands car park, and it hires surfboards and wetsuits from a shop behind the dunes at Croyde Beach. Lessons cover children from age 4 through to intermediate and advanced surfers.
offers: Coach and Ride refresher with kit hire for the rest of the day (ages 10+)
where: Saunton Sands car park (EX33 1LG); hire shop at the Croyde Bay holiday resort car park behind Croyde Beach
goodToKnow: No more than six surfers per instructor
Book online; terms and conditions are on the website
gaps: No season or cancellation terms; hire range not detailed
